description: Building a useful Bill of Materials report in Power BI can become complicated quickly. BOM data is usually stored as Parent → Component relationships, while many Power BI visuals work most naturally with a clean, fixed hierarchy such as Product → Assembly → Subassembly → Part. Real BOMs are rarely that simple. Different branches can have different depths, the same component can be used in several assemblies, products can share parts, and quantities need to be multiplied through multiple levels. This can mean flattening recursive data into Level 1, Level 2, Level 3 columns, building Power Query transformations, maintaining custom DAX, or preparing extra tables just to make the structure usable. Ataytis BOM is built specifically for this problem. Map your Parent, Component, and Quantity fields and the visual builds the multi-level product structure directly inside Power BI. Explore it as an interactive hierarchy tree or structured BOM table, calculate exploded quantities automatically, find repeated components, inspect assemblies, and add your existing engineering, manufacturing, purchasing, or inventory fields. Flexible multi-level hierarchies Build BOMs directly from Parent, Component, and Quantity fields. Handle branches with different hierarchy depths without creating a column for every possible level.
